name: 46214 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46214 (Indianapolis) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46214 (Indianapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46214 (Indianapolis) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
